text:
James: kicking off the NovaCorp POC — they want fast answers on SSO (Okta), SCIM sync for provisioning, RBAC role mapping, and domain-claiming for their apps. also need a pricing ballpark (hosted vs dedicated) for ~10k MAUs, 3k active users, and ~100k tokens/mo. who can own tech presales?

Selene: I can take tech presales on this. quick checklist: 1) test Okta tenant + SAML metadata 2) SCIM base URL + auth method 3) sample role mapping (idp role -> Redwood group) 4) expected concurrency/peaks. can we get an Okta admin contact?

James: okta admin is sara@novacorp.com. they asked about SCIM delta vs full-sync and rate limits. also want example SAML attributes we accept.

Selene: SCIM: we support SCIM 2.0, incremental (PATCH) for delta, and bulk imports for first-time sync. rate limits depend on plan — for hosted starter it's 60 req/min, for dedicated we can increase or eliminate limits with reserved capacity. for SAML attributes we typically need: `name`, `email`, `groups` (optional), `roles` (if IdP sends them). example metadata snippet:```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.example.com">
  <IDPSSODescriptor>...
</EntityDescriptor>
```

Priya: pricing quick note: hosted per-token pricing + SCIM per-user sync tier. for 100k tokens/mo hosted estimate ~ $X/month (I'll DM exact numbers — need to know whether they want streaming tokens counted differently). Dedicated: base reserved capacity + usage; starting commit for predictable latencies likely higher but unit cost lower at scale. need expected concurrency and SLA requirement to firm quote.

Marcus: from runtime side: if NovaCorp needs low-latency under 150ms P95, recommend Dedicated with pinned model version and GPU pool sized for their concurrency. also call out quantization tradeoffs if they want cheaper runs.

Anya: security side: I'll own the security questionnaire. please add contact security@novacorp.com and attach their completed doc. checklist from our side: SOC2 attestation present? encryption in transit+at-rest? KMS for Private deployments? audit log retention length? we also need any contractual language on domain-proofing.

James: onboarding asks: domain-claiming — they need to lock `app.novacorp.com` and allow subdomain mapping. how long does domain verification take?

Selene: domain verification flow: we support DNS TXT ownership and email-based claims for the administrative contact. DNS TXT is faster (once they add record, verification usually completes within minutes). for multi-tenant mapping we recommend their team create CNAMEs pointing to our ingress. note: domain proofing is required for SAML audience restrictions and to prevent tenant takeover.

Priya: follow-ups for quote: expected avg tokens per request, peak concurrent requests, retention for logs (affects storage). can you confirm their decision window (POC -> Prod) and whether they're evaluating pricing vs self-hosting?

James: they want POC this month, prod in ~8 weeks if POC passes. they are comparing to self-hosted inference but care mostly about latency SLA and compliance.

Anya: for the security questionnaire I need contact + whether they require any custom DPA clauses. Also: do they need on-prem (air-gapped) or VPC private deployment? that changes contract/ops notes.

James: they prefer VPC/private deployment (not air-gapped) and will request our DPA + security package. added security@novacorp.com to thread.

ops-bot: ticket #S-7842 created for NovaCorp POC (assign: Selene, Anya, Marcus). ETA for internal prep: 48h.

Selene: next steps from me: 1) set up test Okta SAML flow with sara 2) share SCIM endpoint + sample Postman 3) draft role mapping doc for NovaCorp to confirm. expect first run tomorrow. :thumbsup:

James: perfect — i'll book a sync with NovaCorp for 10:00am PT tomorrow and share calendar invite. thanks team!

Priya: I'll drop an initial hosted vs dedicated ballpark in #pricing-dm and attach a spreadsheet before the sync.

Anya: I'll start the security questionnaire draft and post initial answers in this thread by EOD.

Marcus: i'll prepare a small perf-run config and list recommended model/quantization options for the POC.

James: awesome — closing loop. if anyone needs additional info from NovaCorp before sync, ping me.
